x: Others worthy of mention were Smithers (220 - 23.9, L.J. 19'9") Cornelius (220- 24.0 100 - 10.7), Don Maclean, Laurie O'Hara and Dave Baines.
Typical of our win in the senior event was Dave Cocks's victory in the 880 yds in which he finished in 1:55.5 some eight seconds ahead of the second man who was another Belgravian, Dave Baines.

A flat out first lap by Bill Kerr and Dave Baines broke up the senior mile field straight away but Geoff North and Tony Fairclough had to run the next three laps in their respective lonesome positions of 1st and 2nd.
